name: Adra

attributes.attribute: husband of Cesair, the land's first settler
father of both Adra and Cesair
another figure said to be Cesair's mate

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Adra is an Irish hero. His byname is 'the ancient'. In the Book of Invasions, the mythic history of Ireland, he is the husband of Cesair. Cesair is the island's first settler. The marriage is incestuous. Bith is the father of both. The surviving texts conflict. They make it hard to say if Adra is the same figure as Ladra, who is also said to be Cesair's mate.
objective: Describe Adra as the husband of Cesair in the Book of Invasions.
key_results: Names Adra as the husband of Cesair
Notes the marriage is incestuous because Bith fathered both
Flags that Adra may be the same figure as Ladra.
evidence: Monaghan, The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore, s.v. Adra.
